name: HGNCVS
title: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee Gene Names (HGNC)
publisher: 衛生福利部中央健康保險署

contact.name: 衛生福利部中央健康保險署

description: This value set includes all HGNC Codes. Gene IDs from HGNC must be sent with the HGNC gene ID including the prefix 'HGNC:' as the code and the HGNC 'gene symbol' as display. Example: { "system": "http://www.genenames.org", "code": "HGNC:1100", "display": "BRCA1" }
